#Standardize and scale predictors 
```{r}
#standardizing predictors
data$mean_temperature_c <- scale(data$mean_temperature_c)
data$max_temperature_c <- scale(data$max_temperature_c)
data$mean_light_lux <- scale(data$mean_light_lux)
data$bottom_do <- scale(data$bottom_do)
data$bottom_salinity <- scale(data$bottom_salinity)
data$urchin_site_density <- scale(data$urchin_site_density)
data$mean_current <- scale(data$mean_current)

data$ts_site_density <- scale(data$ts_site_density)
```


#Global model
```{r}
#starting with a minimal model (only random effects)
base_model <- glmmTMB(urchin_density ~ treatment*gravel_size  + (1 | site) + (1 | month), 
                      family = tweedie(link = "log"), 
                      data = data)

#predictor_list <- c( "mean_temperature_c", "max_temperature_c", "mean_current", "bottom_do", "bottom_salinity", "urchin_site_density")

predictor_list <- c("treatment:urchin_site_density",
                     "treatment:mean_temperature_c", "treatment:max_temperature_c",
                     "treatment:mean_light_lux", "treatment:mean_current",
                     "treatment:bottom_do", "treatment:bottom_salinity", "gravel_size:urchin_site_density", "gravel_size:mean_temperature_c",
                     "gravel_size:max_temperature_c", "gravel_size:mean_light_lux",
                     "gravel_size:mean_current", "gravel_size:bottom_do",
                     "gravel_size:bottom_salinity", "urchin_site_density", "urchin_site_density:mean_temperature_c",
                     "urchin_site_density:max_temperature_c", "urchin_site_density:mean_light_lux",
                     "urchin_site_density:mean_current", "urchin_site_density:bottom_do",
                     "urchin_site_density:bottom_salinity",
                     "mean_temperature_c", "mean_temperature_c:max_temperature_c", "mean_temperature_c:mean_light_lux",
                     "mean_temperature_c:mean_current", "mean_temperature_c:bottom_do",
                     "mean_temperature_c:bottom_salinity", "max_temperature_c",
                     "max_temperature_c:mean_light_lux", "max_temperature_c:mean_current",
                     "max_temperature_c:bottom_do", "max_temperature_c:bottom_salinity",
                     "mean_light_lux", "mean_light_lux:mean_current",
                     "mean_light_lux:bottom_do", "mean_light_lux:bottom_salinity",
                     "mean_current", "mean_current:bottom_do",
                     "mean_current:bottom_salinity", "bottom_do",
                     "bottom_do:bottom_salinity", "bottom_salinity")
```

#AIC selection
```{r}
#initialize variables
selected_predictors <- c()
current_model <- base_model
current_aic <- AIC(base_model)
converged <- FALSE

#stepwise selection loop
while (!converged) {
  converged <- TRUE
  
  # Forward selection
  for (predictor in setdiff(predictor_list, selected_predictors)) {
    formula <- as.formula(
      paste("urchin_density ~ treatment*gravel_size +", 
            paste(c(selected_predictors, predictor), collapse = " + "), 
            "+ (1 | site) + (1 | month)")
    )
    new_model <- glmmTMB(formula, family = tweedie(link = "log"), data = data)
    new_aic <- AIC(new_model)
    
    if (new_aic < current_aic) {
      current_model <- new_model
      current_aic <- new_aic
      selected_predictors <- c(selected_predictors, predictor)
      converged <- FALSE
    }
  }
  
  # Backward elimination
  for (predictor in selected_predictors) {
    remaining_predictors <- setdiff(selected_predictors, predictor)
    formula <- as.formula(
      paste("urchin_density ~ treatment*gravel_size +", 
            paste(remaining_predictors, collapse = " + "), 
            "+ (1 | site) + (1 | month)")
    )
    new_model <- glmmTMB(formula, family = tweedie(link = "log"), data = data)
    new_aic <- AIC(new_model)
    
    if (new_aic < current_aic) {
      current_model <- new_model
      current_aic <- new_aic
      selected_predictors <- remaining_predictors
      converged <- FALSE
    }
  }
}

#print results
print(selected_predictors)
summary(current_model)

```
